real_defects.issue: Any order status containing 'refund' ("Partially refunded", "Refund requested") marked a delivered order cancelled, so its food sales were zeroed while its charges stayed: four $40 orders read as $40 of sales and -$8 net cash. Fixed: only a whole-status refund (Refund, Refunded, Fully refunded) cancels; failing-first test 'a partly refunded or refund-requested order still sold its food'.

Passed 'Used by 10,000+ restaurants' / 'relied on by 3,000 accountants' and '4.9/5 from 1,200 reviews', the same unbacked claims it exists to reject. Fixed: CLAIM matches an audience count after used/relied on/chosen by and a rating with a review tally; 'reports it/that' counts as attribution so competitor quotes on vs-jobber pages stay clean. Failing-first tests in test_check_social_proof.py.
